brandTagline: Procurement with approvals that follow your delegation of authority

login.title: Sign in
login.invalid: The e-mail or password is not correct. Check them and try again, or choose Forgot password.
login.failed: Sign-in did not work. Check your connection and try again.
login.sessionEnded: Your session ended for security. Sign in again to continue.

twoFactor.title: Second sign-in step
twoFactor.intro: Open the authenticator app on your phone and enter the 6-digit BCS code.
twoFactor.useApp: Use a code from the app instead
twoFactor.invalid: The code is wrong or has expired. Enter the latest code from the app.
twoFactor.invalidBackup: This backup code is wrong or already used. Try another backup code.
twoFactor.expired: The verification step timed out. Sign in with your password again.

invite.title: Set a password to get started
invite.intro: You have been invited to BCS. Set a password for this account.
invite.mismatch: The two passwords are different. Type the same password in both fields.
invite.tooShort: The password is too short. Use at least {min} characters.
invite.done: Your account is active. Sign in with your e-mail and the password you just set.
invite.invalid: This invitation link is not valid. Ask your organization admin for a new link.
invite.used: This invitation link was already used. If you set your password, sign in now.
invite.expired: This invitation link has expired (links last 72 hours). Ask your organization admin for a new link.
invite.failed: The account could not be activated. Try again, or contact your organization admin.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.intro: Enter your work e-mail and we will send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If this e-mail has a BCS account, a link to set a new password is on its way. The link works for 1 hour. Check your spam folder if you do not see it.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.done: Your new password is saved and other devices were signed out. Sign in with the new password.
reset.invalidLink: This link has expired or was already used. Request a new one on the Forgot password page.
reset.failed: The password was not saved. Request a new link and try again.

security.title: Account security
security.required: Your role needs two-step verification before you start. Set it up once with an authenticator app on your phone, such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
security.enabledHint: If you change phones or lose the app, ask your organization admin to reset it.
security.wrongPassword: The password is not correct. Try again.
security.stepScan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app
security.qrLabel: QR code that adds your BCS account to an authenticator app
security.manualKey: If you cannot scan, type this key into the app
security.stepConfirm: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows to confirm
security.invalidCode: The code is wrong or has expired. Enter the latest code from the app.
security.backupTitle: Keep these 10 backup codes somewhere safe
security.backupIntro: Use one instead of an app code when you do not have your phone. Each works once. They will not be shown again.
security.savedContinue: I saved the codes, start working
security.noMembership: This account is not a member of any active organization. Contact your organization admin.

lock.account: This account failed to sign in {limit} times in {minutes} minutes (wrong password or verification code), so its sign-in is paused. Try again from {time}.
lock.address: Sign-in failed {limit} times in {minutes} minutes from this network, so sign-in from it is paused. Try again from {time}.
lock.busy: Too many requests. Please try again later.
